### This MOD is WIP!
WELCOME TO **BurgerCraft!** a mini mod which adds new items and blocks!
here are all the stuff this mod contains!

![The logo of BurgerCraft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b02d26e5c020484e47e339f5564b2196261660cd.png)

# Blocks:
1. Burger stand:You can now use it as a functional stand. Combine a standard Burger and a Diamond Sword to make ZA ULTIMATE Burger Sword. (Support for the pickaxe is coming soon!)

# Items:
1. **Burger**: you can eat, and use the burger stand to make the burger sword.
2. **Burger** **Sword**: A sword thats a burger.. hehe.. burger sword.. heha hahhaa hahahahahaha. hahahahhaaha hahahehheahahhahaahha
3. **Lettuce**: used to make the burger or consume to gain 1 hunger. replaced grass to drop lettuce
4. **Cheese**: currently only used for making burgers!
5. **Burger Shard**: a high-tier item obtained from combining 9 burgers together. Not eatable!
6. **Infected Burger**: eatable but gives poison III for 5 seconds... eat at your own risk!

  
  Keep in mind, this is my first mod i made using MCreator 
  if i get more experienced with MCreator. i'll update this more, adding newer blocks. and mobs too!

# NOTE (**IMPORTANT**)
THIS MOD ONLY SUPPORTS 1.21.8! I'm planning to only make this work this particular because its too much work...
